build_r2d2_learner: build an R2D2 learner with an RNN network, target network, and replay dataset for recurrent DQN training
run_r2d2_step: run a single learning step on the R2D2 learner that samples replay data and applies gradient updates
review_r2d2_init: review the R2D2Learner constructor to understand hyperparameters like discount, burn-in length, and learning rate
summarize_compute_priority: summarize the compute_priority function that calculates a weighted mixture of max and mean sequence errors
test_r2d2_state: test the R2D2Learner state property to verify checkpointable components like network and optimizer are returned
